subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Gift Card Payment Scam
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Gift Card Payment Scam.

hook.text: The IRS calls and says you owe back taxes. They want payment in iTunes gift cards.

buildup.text: Gift cards are untraceable once the codes are read. They function like anonymous cash.

discovery.text: No legitimate organization — government, business, or utility — accepts gift cards as payment.

twist.text: Scammers drain the cards within minutes of getting the codes, making recovery impossible.

climax.text: Victims lost $228 million to gift card scams in 2022 alone.

punchline.text: If they ask for gift cards, it's always a scam. Always.

quiz.question: Why do scammers prefer gift card payments?
options: Gift cards are untraceable once codes are shared
